HappyHorseImageToVideoApi.description: Generate a video from a first-frame image using the HappyHorse model.

HappyHorseReferenceVideoApi.description: Generate a video featuring a person or object from reference materials with the HappyHorse model. Supports single-character performances and multi-character interactions.

HappyHorseTextToVideoApi.description: Generates a video based on a text prompt using the HappyHorse model.

HappyHorseVideoEditApi.description: Edit a video using text instructions or reference images with the HappyHorse model. Output duration is 3-15s and matches the input video; inputs longer than 15s are truncated.

Wan2ImageToVideoApi.description: Generate a video from a first-frame image, with optional last-frame image and audio.

Wan2ReferenceVideoApi.description: Generate a video featuring a person or object from reference materials. Supports single-character performances and multi-character interactions.

Wan2TextToVideoApi.description: Generates a video based on a text prompt using the Wan 2.7 model.

Wan2VideoContinuationApi.description: Continue a video from where it left off, with optional last-frame control.

Wan2VideoEditApi.description: Edit a video using text instructions, reference images, or style transfer.

WanImageToImageApi.description: Generates an image from one or two input images and a text prompt. The output image is currently fixed at 1.6 MP, and its aspect ratio matches the input image(s).

WanImageToVideoApi.description: Generates a video from the first frame and a text prompt.

WanReferenceVideoApi.description: Use the character and voice from input videos, combined with a prompt, to generate a new video that maintains character consistency.

WanTextToImageApi.description: Generates an image based on a text prompt.

WanTextToVideoApi.description: Generates a video based on a text prompt.
